author: Jamie Kim
subject: Intro w/ Tara Clark (CTO) - FY22 priorities
body:
Attendees: Tara Clark (CTO), Robin Lopez (Infra Mgr), Abigail Reyes (Dir Network Eng); Orvane: Jamie Kim, Thomas Herrera (SA), Hao Stewart

- Tara owns all infra + EUC budget. Came from a shop that standardized on Orvane; openly prefers one vendor across client, server, storage.
- FY22: Windows 11 migration (starting late in year), DC refresh, ransomware resilience, hybrid work.
- Environment: vSphere across 2 DCs (Seattle + Tacoma plant), Oracle Cloud for ERP, third-party backup software on generic disk. Strata 500 for CAD/PLM file data.
- Ransomware: had a scare on a plant file share last year. Wants immutable copies - opening for Vault.
- Tara: "Bring me a 3-year plan, not a quote."

Actions: Jamie - 3-yr infra roadmap draft; Thomas - Vault immutability overview; Hao - Mesh campus refresh discovery with Abigail.

author: Hao Stewart
subject: Mesh switch refresh - Tacoma plant floor
body:
Hi Adam,

Attaching the revised BOM for the Tacoma plant floor closets (Mesh S1148 PoE, 18 units) with the 10G uplink option you asked for. Abigail said you'd be the one to validate the PoE budget per closet.

Thanks,
Hao Stewart
Networking Specialist | Orvane Technologies

> Undeliverable: adam.pham@luxiumprecision.co - mailbox unavailable

author: Brooke Kim
subject: Vault - big deal lost, small one booked
body:
Closed lost 0065f00004Y93MTAAZ ($156,743) on 1/3 - the full immutable backup design got deferred by finance. Tara didn't accept that: she had us re-scope to a single Vault DP5900 as the immutable target for the plant file shares and signed it personally. Booked yesterday as SO-30083516 ($95,130), on the same 2021 blanket P9521455 as Ashley's Strata 500 (SO-30083497) - already flagged PO amount mismatch.
Third-party backup software stays as the catalog for now - Vault is the target. Next: second appliance for Tacoma once budget opens.

author: Darren Russell
subject: Atlas order status / BMC baseline
body: Robin confirmed the 1U hosts from Christopher's April order (SO-30083383, $146,128) and my December order (SO-30083505, $96,197 - flagged PO amount mismatch) are all in production. Everything from 2021 went on PO P9521455 - they reuse the same PO for the whole year, AP draws it down, and the amounts never match. Next batch of 1U 1-socket nodes going into the Seattle vSphere cluster as ESXi hosts for plant MES apps. Asked for BMC firmware baseline + Orvane Manage plug-in for vCenter. Robin says Tara wants every new host on Orvane going forward.

author: Monica Tremblay
subject: Lost servers to Helixon
body: fyi Robin just told me they bought 6 Helixon hosts for the Q3 refresh. We never even had it as an opp - it ran while Tara was out on leave and procurement did it on price alone (~18% under us on equivalent hosts). Lesson: when Tara isn't in the room we lose.

author: Thanh Gutierrez
subject: Account takeover - Luxium Precision
body:
Picked up Luxium 10/17 after 3 months vacant. Anthony's notes stop in July.
Key facts:
- Tara Clark (CTO) is the power. She brought Orvane back in after the Helixon server loss. All infra decisions go through her.
- Robin Lopez + Jessica Robertson run infra day-to-day. Emily Park is procurement - strict on 3 bids above $250K.
- Installed: ~710 Aster 3 14 G1 + 275 Aster 9 2-in-1s, Cadence 3 Micro / Cadence 7 SFF in plants, Atlas 280 x4 (2022), 2x Strata 500, Vault DP5900s.
- Helixon is the threat on compute.
Plan: re-engage Tara, get FY25 roadmap meeting.

author: James Lefebvre
subject: Infra roadmap FY25-FY27 working session
body:
Attendees: Tara Clark, Jessica Robertson, Linda Nair (Virtualization), Bianca Cohen (DC Ops); Orvane: James Lefebvre, Min-jun Chavez (SA), Seo-yeon's replacement TBD, Hiro Gray

Discussion
- VMware: renewal under the new per-core subscription model roughly doubles their spend. Tara wants to cut host count from 48 to ~30 by moving to denser nodes, and keep the hypervisor option open.
- Options: (1) 3-tier refresh - Atlas 2-socket + Strata 500 for files, (2) Converge HCI for general VMs, Atlas for MES/plant, (3) mixed.
- Linda: storage vMotion pain on current arrays; wants NVMe for the PLM database.
- Bianca: Seattle DC at 8 kW/rack limit, Tacoma ~6 kW. Denser nodes need a power check.
- Tara's framing: one multi-year refresh, ~$1.2M over FY26-27, phased. She'll sponsor it to the CFO. Wants Orvane as sole vendor if numbers work.

Actions
- Min-jun: reference architecture for option 2 + host consolidation math
- James: phased commercial model, include Orvane Financial Services option
- Hiro: firmware/ProCare inventory on current hosts

author: Min-jun Chavez
subject: Interim host quote pulled - not lost
body: Pulled the interim ~$540K host quote we'd been holding for Q4. It's not lost - Tara folded it into the bigger FY27 refresh, so it was never opened as an opp. Mentioning it so nobody counts it as a Helixon loss in the win/loss report.

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Refresh scoping - phase 1 / phase 2
body:
Attendees: Tara Clark (CTO, exec sponsor), Jessica Robertson, Emily Park (Procurement), Bianca Cohen; Orvane: Carly Vaughn, Ananya Ramirez, Min-jun Chavez, Matthew Shah

Agenda: confirm phasing, commercial path, timeline

Phase 1 (April): a handful of Atlas hosts for plant MES + VDI. Quick win, replaces end-of-warranty 1U nodes.
Phase 2 (FY27): core refresh - ~24 Atlas 2-socket nodes + 2x Converge HCI clusters (4 nodes each), Strata 500 expansion for PLM (XTGSY4B filling fast). Opp created: 0065f00004YAMCfAAP $1.24M, close 3/27/26.

Commercial
- Emily: anything over $500K needs 3 bids and a formal eval. Tara will write the justification if we're within 10% of the low bid.
- Board approves capital in October. Tara presenting.
- Helixon is pitching HCI on a non-VMware hypervisor - attractive given VMware renewal costs.

Risks: single-threaded on Tara. Need a second exec (Carly Morin, VP EA?).
Actions: Ananya - Phase 1 quote; Min-jun - phase 2 design doc; Carly - meet Carly Morin.

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Phase 2 proposal v3 + board deck inputs
body:
Hi Tara,

Attaching proposal v3 for the phase 2 refresh. Changes from v2: Converge HCI node count down to 8, Atlas 2-socket count up to 24, ProCare Plus 5-yr, and an Orvane Financial Services option that spreads the spend across FY27-FY28. I also included two slides for your October board deck.

Phase 1 hosts (SO-30083791) are in production and the plant team is happy.

Thanks,
Carly Vaughn
Account Executive | Orvane Technologies

---
Automatic reply: Tara Clark is no longer with Luxium Precision Corporation. For infrastructure matters please contact Jessica Robertson.

author: Ananya Ramirez
subject: Tara gone??
body: @Carly Vaughn heads up - Jessica told me on the phase 1 host health-check call that Tara resigned last week. Last day was the 18th. No replacement named. Our $1.24M is single-threaded on her.

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Who owns phase 2 now?
body:
Call with Jessica re the refresh after Tara's exit.
- No one is signing anything big until a new tech exec is hired. Search is on, Jessica thinks a CIO role (not CTO).
- Carly Morin (VP EA) is interim on vendor matters but "doesn't want to inherit Tara's decisions."
- Tyler Gupta (CISO) also leaving mid-August - security review of the HCI design is stalled.
- Jessica personally still wants the refresh - hosts are out of warranty, VMware renewal is in March.
- Board slot in October probably lost.
Moved opp to upside from commit. Kept close date 3/27/26 for now.

author: Terrence Rao
subject: Where Tara landed
body: fyi saw on LinkedIn Tara Clark is now CIO at another Orvane customer (LE West I think - Carly can you check who covers it?). Could be a reference for phase 2 and a new door for us. Her Luxium contact record still shows Active.

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Intro - Heather Sato (CIO, started 10/6)
body:
Attendees: Heather Sato (CIO), Carly Morin (VP EA), Jessica Robertson; Orvane: Carly Vaughn, Min-jun Chavez, Hiro Gray

- Heather started 10/6. Came from a manufacturer that ran Helixon HCI. Polite but direct: she will re-baseline all infrastructure vendors before committing to anything over $250K.
- Plans a formal RFP in Q1 covering compute, HCI, storage and backup. Our phase 2 proposal will be "an input, not the plan."
- Her priorities: ransomware resilience (still the #1 board topic), VMware cost, simplifying vendor count.
- Asked for: installed base summary, ProCare contract dates, our view on hypervisor alternatives.
- Did not react to the board deck slides we'd prepped for Tara.

Takeaways: deal is back to discovery. Realistic decision April-May, not 3/27. Need to rebuild relationships with Heather + Carly Morin; Emma Russell (CDO) and Devin Kim (AI & Data) may matter for GPU nodes.
Actions: Hiro - installed base + ProCare report by 11/7; Min-jun - hypervisor-neutral design; Carly - exec briefing with our regional VP.

author: Ananya Ramirez
subject: Bridge hosts booked
body: SO-30083917 ($53,070, P6569340) - two Atlas hosts to bridge the MES cluster until phase 2. Phase 1 (SO-30083791, $120,288, April) is all Tara got done. Heather signed this one because it was small and "already in flight," but said phase 2 goes to RFP. No opp on it - booked straight from quote.

author: Darren Park
subject: Vault order - no Tara this time
body: Closed won 0065f00004YAGpTAAX Vault DP x1 ($239,184) - the Tacoma appliance (DP8900). SO-30083919 $255,927 incl ProCare, on their FY blanket P0526837. The July version (0065f00004YAIGOAA5) was closed lost while Tara was on her way out. Tara used to approve these in one email; this one took Carly Morin + Jessica + three months. DP5900s Y2XP7RD / GVSW1GS at ~65%. Third-party backup software renewal comes up in FY27 - full Vault displacement was Tara's idea; nobody is pushing it now.

author: Min-jun Chavez
subject: Technical re-baseline workshop
body:
Attendees: Linda Nair (Virtualization), Jessica Robertson, Courtney Marshall (Storage Admin), Emily Rao (ML Eng); Orvane: Min-jun Chavez, Ananya Ramirez, Matthew Shah, Darren Park

- VMware renewal March 2026. Heather asked team to price one alternative hypervisor. Linda worried about plant MES vendor support on anything but vSphere.
- Hosts: 48 today, target 28-32. Atlas 2-socket w/ 64 cores, 1TB RAM per node gets them there.
- Storage: Strata 500 XTGSY4B at ~92%, ~4 TB/mo - PLM growth. R4X330Y ~72%. Need expansion now, not FY27.
- Vault: new DP8900 (CMTR563) landing; DP5900s Y2XP7RD / GVSW1GS ~65%. Darren to bring capacity plan.
- AI: Emily's team wants 2 GPU nodes (48GB class) for vision QA on the line. Fits Atlas AI.
- Linda asked for hypervisor-neutral sizing so we can respond to RFP either way.

Actions: Min-jun - two BOMs (vSphere / alt hypervisor); Matthew - Strata 500 expansion shelves quote (needs to close this quarter); Darren - Vault capacity plan.

Also Shannon Baker (virtualization) left end of November, still Active. And Matthew's Strata shelves deal (0065f00004YAJuvAAH) needs a PO by Friday. Want me to clean up or will you?

author: Carly Vaughn
subject: Pipeline update - Luxium
body:
- Matthew's Strata Shelves x9 (0065f00004YAJuvAAH, $170,531) closed 12/12 - SO-30083931 on PO P4374478. Buys XTGSY4B a few months; storage scope stays in the RFP.
- 0065f00004YAMCfAAP ($1.24M): moving close to 4/30 after RFP schedule. Still showing 3/27 until forecast call. CRM says Prospecting, which is honest.
- Server specialist seat empty since Ananya left 12/30 - need coverage for RFP. Ahmed Vargas (services, started 1/5) owns the ProCare/deployment section.
- Competitors: Helixon (Heather's former vendor) is the favorite going in.
- Tara: now CIO elsewhere. Asking the AE who covers her new company for an intro - possible reference call for Heather, and a way to find out what Tara told her successor about us.
